blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Sen. Jinggoy Estrada on Sunday warned against declaring Chinese Ambassador to the Philippines Jing Quan persona non grata, saying hasty decisions could have consequences despite the envoy’s controversial remarks on China’s military strength. “Declaring a persona non grata is easy to say, but taking responsibility for its consequences is not easy to bear,” Estrada said in a statement. “Hasty action in response to the Chinese envoy’s remarks will not bring any good,” he added.
